admin-required: You need to be an admin of this organization.
agent-cannot-migrate: This server's agent can't run migrations; update it.
agent-has-no-token: This server's agent has no identity yet: reinstall it from the servers page.
agent-needs-swarm: Only Swarm servers run an agent.
agent-stopped-responding: The agent stopped responding halfway; the deploy was given up.
agent-too-old: This server's agent is too old to deploy: press «Update agent».
already-recording: This call is already being recorded.
bad-doc-tab: That isn't one of the document's sections.
bad-doc-version: That version isn't part of this document.
bad-docker-secret-name: That isn't a secret cac created.
bad-freq: That repeat isn't one this can do.
bad-image-repo: That isn't an image repository (no tag, like ghcr.io/org/repo).
bad-kind: That kind of node doesn't exist.
bad-limit: That page size isn't a number.
bad-migrate-command: The migration command has to be a single line.
bad-range: That part of the file doesn't exist.
bad-secret-name: That secret name isn't valid: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, up to 40.
bad-service-name: That isn't a stack or service name.
bad-signature: The GitHub delivery's signature isn't valid.
bad-status: That status doesn't belong to this list.
bad-transition: That status can't follow this one.
bad-wall-time: That time of day doesn't look right.
bad-workflow: That isn't a workflow file name (like prod.yml).
channel-exists: This space already has a channel.
channel-needs-inbox: A channel needs somewhere for the work to land.
channel-other-org: That channel belongs to another organization.
columns-are-fixed: The columns of this board can't be changed.
cycle: That move would put something inside itself.
decision-no-origin: A decision needs something to link back to.
decision-origin-not-here: That task doesn't exist in this organization, so the decision can't point back to it.
deploy-in-flight: There's already a deploy queued or running for this service.
deploy-needs-swarm: Only Swarm servers deploy from cac.
deploy-not-running: That deploy is no longer running.
device-required: A device has to be named for this.
endpoint-not-key-reachable: That endpoint can't be reached with a key.
endpoint-not-scoped: That endpoint isn't for this organization.
general-space-protected: The general room is the organization's channel, not a place for tasks.
github-off: This cac server doesn't have the GitHub App configured.
image-service-not-configured: Images aren't set up on this server.
inbox-other-org: That list belongs to another organization.
insufficient-role: Your role in this organization doesn't reach that.
invalid-agent-token: The agent presented a token that isn't valid; it needs reinstalling.
invalid-body: The request body isn't what this endpoint expects.
invalid-deploy-key: That deploy key isn't valid; mint a new one from the service in cac.
invalid-limit: The limit has to be a number in range.
invalid-offset: The offset has to be a number in range.
invalid-token: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
list-holds-channel-work: This list is holding work that came in through a channel.
list-in-use-by-channel: A channel is pointing at this list.
logout-failed: The server couldn't close the session; you are signed out on this device.
max-5-images: Five images per report is the limit.
meeting-other-org: That meeting belongs to another organization.
no-agent: This request is only for a server's agent.
no-claims: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
no-such-colleague: That person isn't in this organization.
no-weekdays: A weekly meeting needs at least one day.
not-a-colleague: That person isn't in this organization.
not-a-member: You don't belong to this organization.
not-a-user-message: cac wrote this line, not a person — it can't be changed.
not-a-writer-in-org: You can read here, but not write.
not-an-admin: Only an admin of this organization can do that.
not-colleagues: You two aren't in the same organization.
not-found: That doesn't exist, or isn't yours to see.
not-in-cluster: That machine isn't in this cluster.
not-the-author: You can only change what you wrote.
not-the-recorder: Only whoever started this recording, or an admin, can delete it.
nothing-to-roll-back-to: There's nothing before this deploy to go back to.
pat-unsupported: A personal token can't do that.
payload-too-large: What was sent is too large.
push-off: This server doesn't send notifications to devices.
push-subscribe-failed: Couldn't turn on notifications on this device.
push-unsubscribe-failed: Couldn't turn off notifications on this device.
rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
rate-limited-reporter: Too many reports in a row. Give it a moment.
recording-not-ready: This recording is still being put together.
recordings-disabled: Recording isn't set up on this server.
refresh-failed: The server couldn't renew your session. Try again in a moment.
reviewed-needs-a-person: A review is signed by a person, in the app. A token can't sign one.
reviewed-needs-superadmin: Only a superadmin can mark this as reviewed.
ring-outsider: You can only call people in this organization.
rollback-outside-repo: What was there before isn't from this image repository; cac can't go back to it.
room-empty: There's nobody in this call yet.
rotation-needs-deploy: Secrets are only rotated on a service that cac deploys.
same-password: The new password has to differ from the current one.
space-outside-org: That space isn't in this organization.
store-disabled: That store is switched off on this server.
superadmin-only: Only a superadmin can do this.
superadmin-required: Only a platform superadmin can do that.
viewer-read-only: You can look, but not change anything here.
voice-camera-thread-died: The camera failed. Check the voice lab's engine log.
voice-mic-denied: cac doesn't have permission to use the microphone. Turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then join again.
voice-mic-timeout: The microphone didn't open in fifteen seconds.
voice-no-screen-capture: This system can't capture the screen.
voice-screen-denied: The system didn't grant the screen.
voice-screen-thread-died: Screen capture failed. Check the voice lab's engine log.
voice-share-pending: Screen sharing is already being asked for — answer the system dialog.
voice-unconfigured: Voice isn't set up on this server.
webhook-failed: The GitHub delivery couldn't be processed; GitHub will retry it.
kubernetes-superadmin-only: Only a platform administrator can register or convert a Kubernetes server.
connection-admin-only: Only an organization admin can change where a server connects (host, user or ports).
desktop-only: This is only available in the cac desktop app.
bad-push-endpoint: This browser's push service isn't supported.
too-many-push-devices: You already have the maximum number of devices receiving alerts. Turn one off first.
push-not-yours: This browser is still subscribed for someone else. Try again.
proxy-off: Integrations aren't available on this server right now.
invite-required: That person isn't in any of your organizations: invite them.
invalid-url-ticket: The link expired. Reload the page.
bad-cursor: That page link is no longer valid; reload the list.
device-not-found: That device has no telemetry (or it was purged).
voice-removed: You were removed from the call.
voice-joined-elsewhere: You joined this call from somewhere else, so this window left it.
voice-mic-denied-web: The browser didn't allow the microphone. Allow it from the address bar and join again.
voice-camera-denied-web: The browser didn't allow the camera. Allow it from the address bar and try again.
voice-mic-busy: Another program is using the microphone.
voice-camera-busy: Another program is using the camera.
invite-invalid: This link doesn't open any call.
invite-expired: This invite has expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
invite-revoked: This invite was closed by whoever sent it.
invite-full: This invite already let in everyone it was meant for.
guest-removed: You were removed from this call.
guest-name-required: Write your name so the others know who you are.
kick-member-not-allowed: Only guests can be removed from a call.
recording-needs-space: This call isn't attached to a channel, so it can't be recorded.
not-the-host: Only whoever opened this call, or an admin, can close it.
guest-rejected: You weren't let into this call.
guest-not-waiting: That person is no longer waiting.
